title: Malignance
physical_identity: Pristine white tiled rooms and corridors with regenerating surfaces; a single long hallway branches to sixteen large rooms of medical supplies or empty healing 'Detox Zones'. Later corrupted by Decay (black pits, buckling walls).
scale_topology: Roughly one square mile; indoor; one main hallway with left/right branches; no vertical structure stated.
anomalies: surfaces cannot be dirtied and regenerate
Detox Zones rapidly heal wounds and illness
Detox Zones malfunction and mutate flesh in Decay state
entry by noclip impossible after Decay
lighting_sound: Blinding white; sound not stated. Chemical smell and rancid humid air are testimony.
hazards: corrupted Detox Zones causing tumours/allergic collapse/fluid overproduction

entrances.conditions: M.E.G. manages entry; Dead Zone: sanctioned operatives only
entrances.quote: accessed by no-clipping through a white wall near Base Alpha in Level 1

exits.method: No-clip into either end of the main hallway
exits.quote: One may return to Level 1 by no-clipping into either end of the main hallway.

signature_mechanic: A healing sanctuary whose Detox Zones heal painfully; in the Decay variant the same zones reverse healing and black pits consume items.
conflicts_notes: Sixteen large rooms vs 'all eight zones'. Level reclassified as Dead Zone; Director says noclip entry impossible yet personal log noclips in with ID.

key_quotes.quote: roughly one square mile of white rooms and corridors
exposure to these Detox Zones will rapidly heal them
One may return to Level 1 by no-clipping into either end of the main hallway.
we can't even no-clip into the level anymore
